Class ComparativeAnalyticsExporter

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.export.ComparativeAnalyticsExporter
public final class ComparativeAnalyticsExporter extends Object

Comparative Analytics Exporter

Handles asynchronous file export pipelines for comparative multi-scenario simulations:

  • Markdown Reports: Formatted scientific audit and comparative reports with timestamped filenames.
  • 1D CSV Telemetry: Multi-scenario chronological series with interpolated metric tables.
  • 2D Cartography ZIP Archives: Deflated archives containing spatial metric summaries, differential delta maps, and cached tensor raster channels.

Since:
1.0.0
Author:
Ether Architectural Refactoring Engine
